Name: Cluster Port
Description: UDP port players connect to. The cluster then hands each player to a region

Name: Region Ports
Description: UDP port range for the regions. Each region listens on the first port plus its ServerIndex, so every ServerIndex in ClusterConfig.xml must be lower than the range size

Name: Steam Query Port
Description: UDP port for the Steam server browser. Only used when the cluster is listed

Name: Knowledge Base Port
Description: TCP port for the in-game knowledge base web page, which opens when players join
